mapper.select: SELECT se.CORP_GR AS corpGr , se.SERIES_G1 AS seriesG1 , se.SERIES_G2 AS seriesG2 , se.SERIES_GB AS seriesGb , se.SERIES_NM AS seriesNm , se.RET_SUSU AS retSusu , se.RET_SUSU_GB AS retSusuGb , se.FUTURES_INCLUDE AS futuresInclude , se.USED AS used , se.RE_SEOLJ_YEAR AS reSeoljYear , se.SINTAK_GIGAN AS sintakGigan , se.BOSU_GIGAN AS bosuGigan , se.MOKPYO_SUIK_PER AS mokpyoSuikPer , se.PRE_BASIC AS preBasic , se.BASIC_PER AS basicPer , se.SUCCESS_PER AS successPer , se.MAGAM_USED AS magamUsed , se.DP_USED AS dpUsed , se.BM_GR AS bmGr , se.GUGAN AS gugan , se.GA AS ga , se.BIGO AS bigo FROM SZX0SE se WHERE se.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} ORDER BY se.USED DESC, se.SERIES_G1 ASC, se.SERIES_G2 ASC
